column1: # HELD O-GLYCOPROTEASES -- written for proteases.tsv, not shipped yet
# These rows are exactly what proteases.tsv will carry. They are held out of it
# because, with DigestionParams.RespectCleavagePromotingModifications off (the
# default, and the only setting MetaMorpheus can choose today), each one is a
# cut before every Ser and Thr, and MetaMorpheus lists every dictionary entry in
# its protease pickers. The tests load this file through
# ProteaseDictionary.LoadAndMergeCustomProteases (HeldGlycoproteases.Register),
# which parses it exactly as it parses proteases.tsv. Move the rows into
# proteases.tsv, in its O-GLYCOPROTEASES section, once MetaMorpheus can set the
# flag, and delete this file.
# OpeRATOR (OgpA, Akkermansia muciniphila, MEROPS M11), IMPa (Pseudomonas
# aeruginosa, MEROPS M88) and SmE (Serratia marcescens, peptidase_M60/PF13402)
# all cleave N-terminal to a glycosylated Ser/Thr -- the glycan is at P1'. The
# condition syntax (";", "!", ">=") is described in proteases.tsv. The three
# differ:
#   OpeRATOR  optimal on core 1; NOT cleaved on the Tn antigen; blocked by
#             alpha-2,6-sialylation and by core 2; alpha-2,3-sialyl core 1 is
#             turned over ~170x slower. Sialidase co-treatment is standard.
#             Encoded: at least Hex1HexNAc1 at P1' (core 1, so not Tn), and no
#             glycan with HexNAc2 or more (core 2). Not encoded: sialylation,
#             whose linkage a composition cannot tell apart.
#             Trastoy et al., Nat Commun 2020, doi:10.1038/s41467-020-18696-y
#   IMPa      broad: sialylated and asialylated glycans alike, no sialidase
#             needed. Will not cleave when P1 is aspartate, nor between two
#             adjacent O-glycosites (a glycan at P1 forbids the cut). Isoleucine
#             and arginine at P1 are strong efficiency penalties (8% and 38%
#             completion), not refusals. Encoded: "[D]|" for aspartate at P1 and
#             "P1:!O-glycan" for adjacent glycosites. Not encoded: the penalties.
#             Vainauskas et al., Anal Chem 2022, doi:10.1021/acs.analchem.1c04055
#   SmE       broadest glycan tolerance of the three, and unlike IMPa it DOES
#             cleave between two adjacent glycosites, so it has no P1 condition.
#             Chongsaritsinsuk et al., Nat Commun 2023, doi:10.1038/s41467-023-41756-y
# Composition floors: nothing populates Modification.MonosaccharideComposition
# yet, and an unknown composition counts as meeting a REQUIRED floor and as not
# matching a FORBIDDEN one, so on today's databases OpeRATOR cuts as a plain
# "P1':O-glycan" would.
Name
OpeRATOR
IMPa
SmE
OpeRATOR-trypsin|P
IMPa-trypsin|P
SmE-trypsin|P
